name: whisper.cpp / ggml
note: C/C++ library compiled into Voicen through whisper-rs-sys (the crate license covers only its Rust code).

name: Silero VAD model (ggml conversion)
note: Voice activity model of snakers4/silero-vad (https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad) in whisper.cpp's ggml format, ggml-silero-v6.2.0.bin from ggml-org/whisper-vad at the commit in the URL above; its size and SHA-256 are pinned in voicen_core::vad::silero_model::SILERO_MODEL. Downloaded in CI for tests; bundled by T-102.

name: Connection-test speech clip (Lingua Libre, "speech bubble" by Vealhurl)
note: About 1 s of English speech sent by "Test connection" (T-046, decision #59), embedded in the app. Recorded by Vealhurl for Lingua Libre and published on Wikimedia Commons under Creative Commons Zero (Public Domain Dedication). Converted from the 48 kHz mono WAV to raw 16 kHz mono signed 16-bit little-endian PCM (low-pass and decimation, nothing else) as crates/voicen-core/assets/connection-test-speech.s16le.
